Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a wedding caterer in Selaiyur”. Right now maskitchen.in doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.
